en: Black‑and‑white photo of a devastated urban neighborhood: rows of brick building shells and standing chimneys amid rubble and ruined foundations. In the background stands an intact multi‑storey building with a gabled roof and many windows. The handwritten caption at the bottom right reads "Tampere. Tammela." The overall appearance suggests a wartime or post‑conflict ruin scene reproduced as a postcard.
